replacements.before: voldd: ["Relative Volume", "Volume", "This bar's volume divided by this name's own average volume over the prior N bars (default 50). The current bar is not inside its own average. 1.00× is a regular bar. A bar at or above the outlier multiple (default 2×) is an outlier. CAPIT: outlier volume, a new N-bar low, a down close, and the close in the bottom 35% of the bar. STOP: outlier volume at that same low, but the close is in the top 45% of the bar.", "CAPIT is a selling-climax candidate, not a confirmed bottom and not the custom Wyckoff capitulation score. Not day-to-day percent. Not versus the market or SPY. Missing volume stays a gap."],
